bio: This Zurich institution located on Bellevueplatz has housed a restaurant since 1924. Be sure to look around – the walls are adorned with original art by Joan Miró, Marc Chagall, Pierre Bonnard! You can choose to dine in the lively atmosphere of the Brasserie or the more intimate ambience of the Chagall Room. There is also the Swiss Gallery on the first floor. In this beautiful, stylish setting, diners tuck into classic, traditional cuisine at its most heartfelt and satisfying! Much of the food is presented to diners tableside. A signature dish is their Kronenhalle sliced fillet of veal with rösti....
